fitAgainstFrenchDoorRefrigerator.rationale: NS-UZ21 upright freezer implements a single-compartment subset of the frozen french_door_refrigerator refrigeration functional contract. All seven ingested OEM procedures map to existing canonical nodes or documented conditional/overlay bindings: control_board, user_interface, evaporator_fan (freezer instance), defrost_heater (freezer instance), temperature_sensor instances (cabinet/defrost/ambient), compressor (conditional overlay), defrost_sensor (platform overlay). E9 high-temp ladder exercises refrigeration_operation dependencies without inventing new canonical domains.
